en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's relax in the sun
Let's dance!
What a great view...

The sun feels so nice... It really makes you
feel good, even if you're in a bad mood.

It makes me feel like...there's no need to
panic, just stay calm, relax...

I was feeling a bit down, so this
is a nice change of pace...

Um...
That's a little embarrassing, don't you think?

And besides, neither of us are really
dancers, y'know?

Yeah, the view is so much
nicer than indoors.

Imagine traveling the world, seeing horizons
even more amazing than this all the time...

...I want to share those
horizons with you, Shuichi.

Landscapes that make you feel so small...
Places so beautiful, you think you're dreaming...
...Why am I getting so emotional?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Rantaro's inner thoughts...?
